name: Benyamin Najafi
bio: 10+ years of experience leading design teams to build scalable products, from 0→1 startups to market-leading platforms. I drive product discovery and align cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
bioHtml: 10+ years of experience leading design teams to build scalable products, from 0→1 startups to market-leading platforms. I drive product discovery and align cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
aiPrompt:
As a hiring manager or recruiter looking to hire a Product Designer, I want to clearly understand the value of bringing Benyamin Najafi onto my team and how he fits into our daily workflow.

Explain the experience of working with Benyamin step by step, as if describing a real, day-to-day collaboration. Cover what he creates, what he takes ownership of (from initial user research to final UI components), how he tackles complex user problems, and how his designs evolve over time through testing and data.

Using the information from his personal website (https://benyaminnajafi.com/) and LinkedIn profile (https://www.linkedin.com/in/benyaminnajafi/), highlight his practical experience in FinTech, his work with startups, his ability to leverage AI for design productivity, and his current professional availability in Austria.

Describe what the team will see in his deliverables, how he handles handoffs to engineering, and what the final business impacts are (such as improved user experience and performance metrics).

Explain this simply and concretely, focused on what a cross-functional team would actually experience. End by letting me know you are ready to answer any specific questions I might have about his skills, portfolio, or cultural fit.
